stories.title: Protests shutter hundreds of French schools as clashes with police turn violent
stories.reason: About 400 of France's 3,700 high schools closed and nearly 2,000 people have been arrested since the movement began over teacher shortages and overcrowded classrooms, with two Paris schools set ablaze, adding pressure on Macron's government as it also faces a public-sector budget strike.

stories.title: Personal data leaked at three more South Korean banks as AI-powered hacking spreads
stories.reason: Following Shinhan Bank's breach of roughly 25,000 customers' data via AI tools that probed a loan service for vulnerabilities, KB Kookmin, Hana and Busan banks have now also disclosed leaks, prompting emergency inspections across the country's financial sector.

stories.title: Supreme Court's new term opens with a win for Trump on voter verification and a deportation case ahead
stories.reason: The justices let the administration use a modified citizenship-verification database ahead of the midterms over three liberal justices' dissent, and will hear arguments in December on Trump's policy of deporting migrants to third countries, in a term already lined up with major immigration fights.

stories.title: Trump says a $8.4 billion oil project is part of the South Korea deal; Seoul says it never agreed to that
stories.reason: Trump posted that an enhanced-oil-recovery project is included in this week's $200 billion investment package and threatened to double costs elsewhere if Seoul balks, but South Korea's industry ministry says the project was never part of what the two sides actually agreed.

stories.title: A Russian fighter jet reportedly shoots down its own helicopter in a friendly-fire incident, killing three
stories.reason: A Su-35 crew mistook a Russian Mi-8 for a Ukrainian drone and opened fire over Voronezh Oblast, killing the pilot, navigator and gunner, according to Russian and Ukrainian Telegram channels that Russian authorities have not officially confirmed.

stories.title: Google's Project Suncatcher satellite reaches orbit in its first physical step toward space-based AI data centers
stories.reason: The prototype, carrying four Trillium TPUs, launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 and will spend its mission gauging how the chips handle radiation and thermal extremes, an early hardware test rather than an operational data center.

stories.title: Tesla cuts planned memory on its AI5 and AI6 chips to speed up Optimus robot production
stories.reason: Musk said the AI5 chip will now ship with 72GB of RAM and AI6 with 144GB, cuts driven by memory supply constraints that he says won't meaningfully affect Optimus performance since bandwidth, not capacity, was the real bottleneck.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils a real-time transcription model that tops independent accuracy rankings
stories.reason: MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming ranked first among 38 models on Artificial Analysis for both accuracy and latency, launching alongside two new voice-generation models as Microsoft pushes further into the voice AI tools market OpenAI and Google also compete in.
